id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

condition.description:
The switch condition that will decide which component to render.

While the condition type is being imported, a spinner will be temporarily shown,
this behavior cannot be changed but due to optimizations you may not see the spinner
in some cases.

For possible condition types see mixins of {@link UiSdlRenderSwitchCondition}.

componentsToRender.description: The mapping of the value resulting from evaluation of the switch condition, to the component to render for that condition.

fallbackComponent.description:
The component to render when the value from the {@link UiSdlRenderSwitchCondition}
is not present as a key in {@link #componentsToRender}

title: The react component type of {@link UiSdlSwitchRenderer}.
name: UiSdlSwitchRendererReact
